protocol.requirement: Zero adapter must preserve native episodes/impacts and all continuous summary fields except checkpoint, latency and explicit adapter metadata

summary.scope: Scene selected by scene_base with the recorded initial_skill. With pass initialization, a static shooting ball is sampled after observed pass plus recovery delay; shoot initialization is only a scene diagnostic. First-observed impact diagnostics; no robot/history reset at handoff. Failed lanes never re-enter counting; original per-task quality metrics are not reused for second ball.

recovery_audit.scope: Per-tick aggregate activation matches live recovery intervals; no claim of per-row action identity from aggregate records alone

history_audit.scope: Aggregate activation audit; policy routing and unchanged non-RMA input are checked separately
